TOGETHER.title: TOGETHER
TOGETHER.subtitle: Moving Forward Hand in Hand
TOGETHER.narrative: Despite fractures and uncomfortable silences, radical honesty and forgiveness led you both to hold on tighter than before.

REBUILD.title: REBUILD
REBUILD.subtitle: Starting to Rebuild
REBUILD.narrative: Broken trust cannot be repaired overnight. You both accept the raw truth and commit to laying new stones, one step at a time.

HONEST_LOVERS.title: HONEST LOVERS
HONEST_LOVERS.subtitle: Love Without Pretense
HONEST_LOVERS.narrative: The courage to speak unfiltered truth without fear of condemnation has elevated your connection into pure intimacy.

QUIET_LOVERS.title: QUIET LOVERS
QUIET_LOVERS.subtitle: Serenity in Silence
QUIET_LOVERS.narrative: Grand declarations are unnecessary. Simply sitting beside each other and holding each other's vulnerability is more than enough.

BEST_FRIENDS.title: BEST FRIENDS
BEST_FRIENDS.subtitle: An Unshakable Companionship
BEST_FRIENDS.narrative: Deep mutual understanding and ease in being your genuine selves make this bond as enduring as lifelong confidants.

UNFINISHED.title: UNFINISHED
UNFINISHED.subtitle: An Unwritten Chapter
UNFINISHED.narrative: Unanswered questions and unresolved feelings linger in the air. Your journey leaves an open question yet to unfold.

ONE_LAST_CHANCE.title: ONE LAST CHANCE
ONE_LAST_CHANCE.subtitle: One Last Chance
ONE_LAST_CHANCE.narrative: Hope has not extinguished. You both take one final leap of faith to discover if what remains is worth protecting.

FORGIVEN.title: FORGIVEN
FORGIVEN.subtitle: Liberating Forgiveness
FORGIVEN.narrative: Missteps are acknowledged, and genuine forgiveness releases both souls from the lingering weight of past wounds.

MISUNDERSTOOD.title: MISUNDERSTOOD
MISUNDERSTOOD.subtitle: Lost in Translation
MISUNDERSTOOD.narrative: Locked in personal assumptions, unspoken thoughts turn into silence, slowly etching a rift difficult to bridge.

DISTANT.title: DISTANT
DISTANT.subtitle: Growing Distance
DISTANT.narrative: The walls erected for self-protection have turned into a barrier, rendering you faint silhouettes to one another.

SEPARATE.title: SEPARATE
SEPARATE.subtitle: Parting of Ways
SEPARATE.narrative: Accepting that sometimes love alone cannot reconcile irreconcilable differences, you release each other with mutual respect.

STRANGERS.title: STRANGERS
STRANGERS.subtitle: Strangers Again
STRANGERS.narrative: From those who knew each other's secrets to strangers who glance away. Only quiet memories remain as time moves on.
